sources.snippet: Overview stable-diffusion-v1-4 is a latent text-to-image diffusion model developed by CompVis that generates photo-realistic images from text prompts. The model was initialized from the weights of stable-diffusion-v1-2 and fine-tuned for 225,000 steps at 512x512 resolution on the "laion-aesthetics v2 5+" dataset with 10% text-conditioning dropout to improve classifier-free guidance sampling ...
